description: This file defines Express.js routes for session tracking, including GET endpoints with caching, ETag handling, and cache invalidation hooks. It handles query parameters, tenant resolution, and supports pagination, search, and filtering.

methods.name: roundToMinuteISO
methods.description: Rounds a date string to the start of the minute in ISO format.

methods.name: cacheKeyFromReq
methods.description: Generates a deterministic cache key based on request parameters and tenant context.

methods.name: cacheGet
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry if valid, otherwise null.

methods.name: cacheSet
methods.description: Stores a cache entry with payload and ETag, with expiration.

methods.name: invalidateAllSessionTrackingCache
methods.description: Clears all cache entries related to session tracking.

methods.name: computeETag
methods.description: Computes a SHA-1 hash as ETag based on response payload and context.

methods.name: sessionsEarlyBypassDetector
methods.description: Middleware to detect special tenant bypass conditions and set request flags.
